description.p: SyntroSend is the ultimate ultra-fast, zero-cloud P2P file transfer app. Send files of any size between your Linux, Windows, macOS, and Android devices instantly.

Unlike cloud storage apps, SyntroSend transfers your files directly between devices over your local Wi-Fi network, meaning your data never touches a third-party server. Need to send a file to someone across the globe? SyntroSend also supports secure, encrypted global tunnels.

ul.li: Blazing Fast: Transfer gigabytes of data in seconds over local Wi-Fi.
100% Secure & Private: Files are sent directly device-to-device with end-to-end encryption.
Zero Cloud: No servers, no storage limits, and no subscriptions.
Cross-Platform: Works seamlessly across Linux, Android, Windows, and macOS.
Password Protected Transfers: Require a password for receivers to accept files.
Added floating desktop DropZone widget for instant file sending
Added new drag-to-send functionality for nearby devices
Added optional password protection for file transfers
Major performance optimizations, lag fixes, and overall stability improvements
